subject: Next steps: Type II report retrieval + intake questionnaire (HealthSpan)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthspan.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T15:02:00Z
Subject: Next steps: Type II report retrieval + intake questionnaire (HealthSpan)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- HealthSpan asked for Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or an attestation/bridge letter) for vendor review.
- You mentioned a short vendor security intake we should fill out to expedite procurement.
- HealthSpan's security team prefers portal access to grab artifacts when available.

Requested owner actions (from us):
1) I can upload our Type II summary and bridge letter to your trust portal — could you send the invite link or email address to provision?
2) Please share the intake/questionnaire link so our team can complete it this week.
3) Ben (cc'd) will follow up on any redlines or timing constraints from finance/procurement.

If it's helpful, we'll also provide a one-page data processing note outlining GDPR/HIPAA controls specific to the integration. Proposed timeline: upload and questionnaire returned within 3 business days.

Thanks — I'll coordinate on our side once you confirm portal access.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_summary.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthspan.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Ops <secops@healthspan.io>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Type II report retrieval + intake questionnaire (HealthSpan)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. I looped in our Security Ops mailbox so they see the artifacts. A couple quick notes: 

- We need a copy of the Type II report or, if unavailable, a signed bridge letter and the control summary. I can accept a PDF upload to our vendor trust portal.
- Here is the vendor intake questionnaire: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/HealthSpan-Sec-Questionnaire (fills in basic scoping and compliance controls).
- For portal invites, please send the email address you want provisioned. Our portal auto-sends invites and enforces SSO/SAML for access.

Can you provision an account for: security@redwood.ai? If you prefer to share a DocuSign bridge letter instead, upload it and set visibility to "HealthSpan Security".

On timing — our procurement review for this integration is scheduled the week of 2027-05-24, so access and questionnaire completion by 2027-05-21 would keep you on schedule.

Best,
Alice Wong
Sr. Tech Procurement Manager
HealthSpan
alice.wong@healthspan.io

---
Security Ops note: secops@healthspan.io will verify evidence and may ask for supporting logs or encryption attestations during the review.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Security Ops <secops@healthspan.io>, Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthspan.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Type II report retrieval + intake questionnaire (HealthSpan)

Hi Alice / Security Ops —

Thanks — we'll get this turned around. Action items from Redwood: 
- I uploaded a redacted summary PDF of our SOC 2 Type II and a bridge-letter draft to our secure folder and attached the summary to my first mail. We can also upload directly to your portal if you confirm the invite email.
- We've started the HealthSpan questionnaire (link you shared). Ben will complete the technical sections around hosting and encryption; Markus will complete controls for monitoring and incident response.
- Please provision the portal invite to security@redwood.ai and include SSO instructions if available. If provisioning an invite is slow, we can share a temporary DocuSign bridge letter (signed by our Compliance lead) and then transfer artifacts into your portal.

Ben / Markus: assignable tasks below — please confirm ETA by end of day tomorrow.
- Ben: complete hosting/infra answers in the questionnaire; compile flamegraphs for throughput as a separate attachment if asked.
- Markus: attach incident response playbook excerpt and the contact for SOC incident escalations.

I'll draft and sign the bridge letter with Compliance after I hear back from Markus on the incident contact.

Thanks,
Neha

Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx (DOCX, 24KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-19T18:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Type II report retrieval + intake questionnaire (HealthSpan)

Quick status update from Redwood side —

- I finished the infra section in the HealthSpan questionnaire and uploaded a small FAQ about our multi-tenant isolation and encryption-at-rest details into the form (answer fields).
- Markus attached the incident response contact and a short excerpt from the IR plan (we'll upload the full playbook to the HealthSpan portal once invited).
- Neha: I left two clarifying notes in the questionnaire about data retention defaults and regional residency; if SecOps asks for EU data residency options we should surface Redwood Private options.

Next steps for HealthSpan: please send the portal invite to security@redwood.ai so we can upload the signed bridge letter and supplementary artifacts. If you prefer, I can also coordinate a short 20-minute call between Markus and your SecOps reviewer tomorrow morning to walk any technical questions.

Thanks everyone — on track for your procurement week if portal access comes through.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
